# `silk/text/regex`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Native ECMAScript Unicode regular expressions for text and JSON Schema patterns.

## When to use
Use `Regex.compile` and `Regex.test` to reuse a `Pattern` across many searches. Use
`Regex.validate` to check syntax or `Regex.matches` for a one-off unanchored search. Patterns
use the ECMA-262 Unicode (`u`) grammar, not shell glob syntax.

## Details
Matching supports captures, named and numeric backreferences, forward and backward assertions,
alternation, character classes, Unicode properties, greedy and lazy repetition, and scoped
`i`, `m`, and `s` modifiers. Unicode properties and simple case folding use Unicode 17.0.0.
Text is UTF-8: positions advance by Unicode scalars, never by bytes or UTF-16 code units.
Syntax failures and exhausted resource limits are errors, never a negative match.

Import as `Regex` with `import silk.text.regex { Regex }`.

<a id="Pattern"></a>

## `Pattern`

```silk
pub struct Pattern
```

An owned, immutable ECMAScript Unicode regular-expression program.

### Details
Construct it with `Regex.compile` and search any number of strings with `Regex.test`. It owns
decoded instructions and does not borrow the source pattern. Matching does not mutate it.

<a id="Regex.impl.compile"></a>

### Associated function `compile`

```silk
pub effect fn compile(pattern: string) -> Pattern ! RegexError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Compiles an ECMAScript Unicode (`u`) pattern for repeated unanchored searches.

#### Details
Patterns have no surrounding slashes or flags. Scoped `i`, `m` and `s` modifiers are supported.
Captures, backreferences, lookarounds and Unicode property escapes are compiled natively;
property aliases and simple case folding use Unicode 17.0.0. The result owns its instructions
and does not borrow `pattern`.

#### Errors
- `RegexError` for invalid syntax, more than 65,536 pattern bytes, group nesting beyond 256,
  or a repetition bound greater than 1,000,000.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the program.

<a id="Regex.impl.validate"></a>

### Associated function `validate`

```silk
pub effect fn validate(pattern: string) -> () ! RegexError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Checks the entire pattern against the ECMAScript Unicode (`u`) grammar.

#### Details
There are no surrounding slashes or flags. Scoped `(?ims-ims:...)` modifiers are accepted.
Unicode property aliases are exact, case-sensitive Unicode 17.0.0 aliases. Numeric and named
forward references are checked after parsing; duplicate names are allowed only in disjoint
alternatives. Legacy octal and identity escapes are not accepted in Unicode mode.

#### Errors
- `RegexError` for invalid syntax, more than 65,536 pattern bytes, nesting beyond 256 groups,
  or a repetition bound greater than 1,000,000.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the parsed pattern.

<a id="Regex.impl.matches"></a>

### Associated function `matches`

```silk
pub effect fn matches(pattern: string, text: string) -> bool
    ! RegexError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns whether any substring of `text` matches an ECMAScript Unicode (`u`) pattern.

#### Details
The pattern has no surrounding slashes or flags. Matching is case-sensitive, with `.` excluding
LF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029, unless scoped `i`, `m` or `s` modifiers change those rules. Without
`m`, `^` and `$` mean the actual beginning and end, including when text ends in a newline.
`\d` and `\w` are ASCII classes; `\s` is ECMAScript whitespace and line terminators.
Captures, backreferences, lazy repetition and variable-length lookbehind have ECMAScript
backtracking order. Positive lookarounds commit their first successful captures. The Unicode
property and case-folding data version is 17.0.0. Text advances by UTF-8 Unicode scalars.

#### Errors
- `RegexError` for invalid syntax, more than 65,536 pattern bytes, group nesting beyond 256,
  a repetition bound greater than 1,000,000, more than 1,000,000 matcher steps, or recursive
  matching deeper than 1,024 frames. Exhaustion is never reported as `false`.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply the program or matcher state.

<a id="Regex.impl.test"></a>

### Associated function `test`

```silk
pub effect fn test(pattern: &Pattern, text: string) -> bool
    ! RegexError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Searches `text` with a previously compiled ECMAScript Unicode pattern.

#### Details
Searches are unanchored unless the pattern supplies anchors. Captures and repetition use
ECMAScript backtracking order, positive lookarounds are atomic, and lookbehind runs backward.
Text advances by Unicode scalars. The pattern is immutable; input and backtracking storage
belong to this invocation. Unicode properties and folding use Unicode 17.0.0.

#### Errors
- `RegexError` with `MatchLimit` after 1,000,000 matcher steps or 1,024 recursive frames.
  Exhaustion is never reported as `false`.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the allocator cannot supply input or matcher storage.
